title: Loot
html:
Loot is gear from monsters and chests. Color ranks, member-use percents, and soulbind rules are on Items.

Mythic drop odds are on Rainbow Drops. Named lair-chest rainbows are on Boss Lair Rainbows. Which shared-pool names can show at your level is on Rainbow Level Bands. Well-only names are on Well-Only Rainbows. Names that no longer drop are on Discontinued Rainbows.
